verdict.rationale: Reflect documents a custom deep-link URI scheme (reflect://reflect?command=...&param=...) for performing in-app actions, but the only command evidenced appends text to today's daily note. Separately, an OAuth REST API can create notes (POST /graphs/{graphId}/notes) and append to daily notes from scripts. That API is a cloud endpoint rather than a way of driving the local app, so creating or opening a specific note from outside the app is only thinly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented deep-link commands to create or open a specific note, a full command list, a local endpoint, and hands-on corroboration.
